name: TC-898: a wind order with a free item, points, a gift card and a tip reads the same money lines at checkout and on the confirmation page

steps.name: sign in as the reward member, redeem points
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In to Existing Account' })
add the free item the promotion offers
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('button', { name: /^You've earned a free / })
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^You've earned a free / })
apply the gift card, pick a tip
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Fill "AUTOGCMWBQRRW5YQVGMK" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Add a Tip' }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: /^15%/ })
the page's /quote settles (none in flight, one 200)
the page's /quote settles (none in flight, one 200)
pay with the Stripe test card
the confirmation marks the gift item with the server's label
